members.name: value
members.doc: Unique id of the item; this is what `value` and `onValueChange` carry.

members.name: title
members.doc: The question or section name shown on the trigger.

members.name: content
members.doc: The content revealed when the item opens.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Keeps the item closed and skips it during keyboard navigation.

types.name: BouncyAccordionProps
types.doc: An accordion that reads as one segmented block while closed. The item you open detaches from its neighbors: the gaps around it widen, the corners on both sides of each gap round off, and everything lands with a small bounce.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: Values of the items open at first when uncontrolled.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Called with the values of the open items after each change.

members.name: multiple
members.doc: Lets several items stay open. By default opening one closes the others.

members.name: gap
members.doc: Gap in px around an open item. Closed neighbors sit 3 px apart.

members.name: radius
members.doc: Corner radius in px of the block's outer corners and of every corner that faces an open gap.

members.name: headingLevel
members.doc: Heading level that wraps each trigger, to fit the page outline.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the root element.
